Yes. Words that are not palindromes but they appear in a very well known palindrome sentence. That’s not hard to grasp. 

And it’s okay that you haven’t ever heard or read “Able was I ere I saw Elba.” So this is a chance to learn, not a chance to whine that other people know something you don’t.

My wife’s Norwegian family love the joke “what’s one thing Sweden has that Norway doesn’t? Nice neighbors,” to which our Swedish friends say “yes, the Finns are lovely.”
It is sad. Up until now the Swedish Chef has been such an accurate depiction of Swedish culture and cuisine …

They’re opening a Swedish chef themed restaurant at Disney World. While this is welcome and long overdue, I hope there is at least some chance that my food could come to life and attack me. Otherwise, what’s the point?

My 10-year-old on dinosaur chicken nuggets: They’re the best. Even if you don’t like dinos, you can just cut off the head, feet, and tails.  And then it’s like you defeated the dinosaurs.
